title: B2b trial configuration
statement: Given three finite Turing machines $M_V,M_I,M_P$ over the Boolean alphabet, a state $q$, an input $x$, a valid input-head position $p$, Boolean words $u,y,z$, and integers $b_p,c_p$, form a configuration on $3+2k_V+2k_I+2k_P$ work tapes, where $k_V,k_I,k_P$ are the machines’ work-tape counts. It is initialized in state $q$ on input $x$ with input-head position $p$; the first three designated word tapes contain $u,y,z$, respectively, all other work tapes are blank, and the work-head positions are $b_p$ on the second designated tape, $c_p$ on the third, and $0$ on every other tape.
hypotheses_covered: Three finite Turing machines over Boolean symbols
An input-head position among the length of x plus two positions
Three Boolean lists u, y, z
Two integer head positions b_p, c_p
